title: Transaction analysis and Fraud detection Intro

cues.en: In this section, we shall create a transaction analysis and fraud detection system using AI.
cues.zh: 這一章使用 AI 建立交易分析與詐欺偵測系統。

cues.en: And then in the next section we shall define what we have built to use machine learning techniques.
cues.zh: 下一章再加入機器學習技術，改善這個系統。

cues.en: Please note we shall first start by implementing a very simplified, yet effective rule based AI system for transaction analysis and fraud detection.
cues.zh: 請注意，我們先實作簡化但有效的規則式 AI 系統，分析交易並偵測詐欺。

cues.en: Then later on, we are going to improve upon it by adding more machine learning techniques.
cues.zh: 之後再加入更多機器學習技術改善。

cues.en: To get us started off, we shall install some packages.
The first one is going to be installing is a package called scikit learn, which is an open source machine learning library.
cues.zh: 第一個是 scikit-learn，這是開源機器學習函式庫。

cues.en: It's quite simple to use and contains a set of Python modules for machine learning and data mining.
cues.zh: 它容易使用，包含機器學習與資料探勘用的 Python 模組。

cues.en: Then, for scikit to work, we also have to install some other dependencies, such as numpy.
cues.zh: scikit-learn 還需要其他相依套件，例如 NumPy。

cues.en: NumPy is an open source set of numerical computing tools.
cues.zh: NumPy 是開源數值運算工具集。

cues.en: Then the next dependency is going to be joblib, which is a set of tools to provide lightweight pipelining in Python.
cues.zh: 接著是 joblib，提供 Python 輕量流程管線工具。

cues.en: Then lastly we have pandas, which is a fast, powerful, flexible and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tools.
cues.zh: 最後 pandas，是快速、強大、有彈性且容易使用的開源資料分析與操作工具。

cues.en: Since we shall be installing new packages, we have to rebuild our containers.
cues.zh: 由於要安裝新套件，必須重新建置容器。

cues.en: So what we have to do first is bring down all our containers.
So let's go back to our terminal.
Then we're going to run make down like that.
Good.
Then let's make sure our virtual environment is still activated.
cues.zh: 再確認虛擬環境仍已啟用。

cues.en: As you can see, mine is still activated.
Then what you're going to do is let's run Pipenv install.
We're going to install a scikit learn version 1.6.1, numpy version 2.2.3 Joblib 1.4.2, and then pandas
Good.
Once all the packages have been installed, let's add our packages to the requirements.txt file by seeing pip freeze, then backend requirements.txt like that.
cues.zh: 套件全部安裝後，執行 pip freeze，輸出至 backend/requirements.txt。

cues.en: Good.
Then let's confirm from our project Explorer.
cues.zh: 再從專案檔案總管確認。

cues.en: So let's just open requirements.txt.
Then we can see we have scikit learn right there.
Good.
Then the rest should also be available such as pandas which is somewhere up here.
cues.zh: 其他套件也應該有，例如上面的 pandas。

cues.en: Good and numpy.
Nice.
Then let's rebuild our containers.
So back in the terminal we're going to run make build.
cues.zh: 回到終端機執行 make build。

cues.en: Good.
Once our containers have been built let's confirm from Docker Desktop.
cues.zh: 建置完成後，從 Docker Desktop 確認。

cues.en: As you can see, all the containers are running well.
Perfect.
That's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we shall add our AI related configuration and enums.
cues.zh: 下一堂加入 AI 相關設定與 enum。
